player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm ad tili Amazan {player_id}. Tqejjemt ar 15-Puzzle.
Tafyirt n wurar ad tili s tefyirt n yifḍan s wadda ɣer yifḍan seg 1 ar 15, s yegri yezegzaw deg wadda n wadda n wakal.
Akken ad txedmeḍ tawla, tzemreḍ ad tsekcemḍ yifḍan s yegri yezegzaw (yettwabdar s snat n tsetḍiwin, am __) s tsexdamt n yiwet n tsexdamin-a:
- 'up': Kemmḍ yifḍan ddu yegri yezegzaw ɣer ufella.
- 'down': Kemmḍ yifḍan n ufella n yegri yezegzaw ɣer wadda.
- 'left': Kemmḍ yifḍan n wakal n yegri yezegzaw ɣer tama.
- 'right': Kemmḍ yifḍan n tama n yegri yezegzaw ɣer wakal.
Akken ad tsekcemḍ tawla, ar tiraḍ tawjihit (am 'up', 'down', 'left', neɣ 'right') deg tsexdamin n wakal, am [up].
Tafyirt n yifḍan n wakal tura tettwabdar ddaw-a. Seqdec tifinagh-a akken ad tḥelleḍ tawla.
